question.problem:
Which of the following values of $v$ satisfy the inequality $7v\le 28\,?$

I. $v=1$

II. $v=3$

III. $v=4$
question.worked_solution:
We substitute each value into the given inequality and check to see if the resulting statement is true or false.

- We substitute the value $v=1$ into the given inequality. We get:

$$
\begin{aligned}7v & \le 28 \\ 7\cdot 1 & \le 28 \\ 7 & \le 28\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

So, substituting $v=1$ into the inequality leads to a **true** statement. 

Therefore, $v=1$ **satisfies** this inequality.

- We substitute the value $v=3$ into the given inequality. We get:

$$
\begin{aligned}7v & \le 28 \\ 7\cdot 3 & \le 28 \\ 21 & \le 28\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

So, substituting $v=3$ into the inequality leads to a **true** statement. 

Therefore, $v=3$ **satisfies** this inequality.

- We substitute the value $v=4$ into the given inequality. We get:

$$
\begin{aligned}7v & \le 28 \\ 7\cdot 4 & \le 28 \\ 28 & \le 28\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

So, substituting $v=4$ into the inequality leads to a **true** statement. 

Therefore, $v=4$ **satisfies** this inequality.
